sentences.en: From the rotten seed comes to us the nutritious fruit.
sentences.zh: 从腐烂的种子中我们得到了营养丰富的果实。

sentences.en: Insects are very nutritious and a good source of protein.
sentences.zh: 昆虫非常有营养，是优质蛋白质的良好来源。

sentences.en: You can't eat it just because it is nutritious.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅因为它有营养就吃它。
